title: iCloud Drive files
whyItMatters: iCloud Drive holds the user's documents and app data, including Desktop and Documents when syncing is on. Signing out does not delete local copies.
source: Apple support and macOS forensics: iCloud Drive content lives in ~/Library/Mobile Documents - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cloud-storage-clients
notes: Online-only files appear as 0-byte placeholders; vacate counts metadata and never hydrates or downloads anything. App-specific iCloud folders are included.
